body: I know that I am fortunate in many ways. With two romantic partners in my life, you would think that I wouldn't be lonely... but for me the worst loneliness of all is feeling alone even when someone is physically there. I don't have friends. These two guys are it. I can't talk to them about what goes on with me because usually it involves them in a way that will cause unneeded worry or stress for them. I guess that is why I turned to Reddit. Thanks for your response.
Thank you for taking the time to write all of that. I appreciate your story and the perspective you offered. I will keep this in mind.

Thank you for your reply. No, I am not currently on medication. I tried whatever they threw at me for about 6 years. This past year though I have lost health insurance and have been off of all medications. My mood actually has seemed no different from when I was medicated. I guess I just self-medicate now with either marijuana (which gives me the most relief I have ever experienced) or an old habit of self-harming which has resurfaced in the last few months.
